title: Build an API reference (docs theme)
summary: Turn a SpiderPublish project into a Stripe-class API reference. Use whenever the user says 'build API docs', 'create an API reference', 'import my OpenAPI/Swagger spec', 'document my API', or 'make docs like Stripe/ReadMe/Mintlify'. Walks through importing an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (which stores structured per-operation data), applying the `docs` theme, and deploying — the result is a three-column reference (nav tree, prose + parameters, a pinned tabbed cURL/Python/JS/Go code panel) with Try-it and Ask-AI.
